mission: Educating the world to impact for Christ
quote:
Education is the food of youth,
the delight of old age,
and the provocation to grace in the soul.

paragraphs.text: NCC Education Group brings together four institutions under one shared mission. From early childhood through to Year 12, and beyond the classroom into the pool, we're focused on **faith, character, and excellence** across Queensland.

Founded on the Sunshine Coast through **Nambour Christian College**, the group has grown to include Gulf Christian College in regional Queensland, NCC Early Learners, and NCC Swimmers.
Each carries its own identity, but all share the same foundation.

How students think. How they treat others.
What they carry with them long after they leave.
That's what we mean by **valuing what matters most.**
